Messages.Author: Gwen Morse
Messages.Body:
Yes, I'm thinking about working on a Ravnos deck :). It just never
ends with me, does it?

Question 1: Horrid Reality. Does this refer to weapons only as
equipment? I would assume it does...since it says "weapon" through the
greater part of the card text. However, the first line refers to the
first peice of "equipment" found in the library. Is this a typo/errata
issue, or, can the Ravnos be forced to equip with a laptop/sport
bike/some other non-weapon equipment (and then have egg on their face
in the ensuing combat as they can't fight for squat)?

Question 2: Illusions of the Kindred. I'm a bit puzzled about what the
card text refers to. It seems to me that it refers to being able to
take an uncontrolled vamp from the bottom of the crypt, fill it with
blood, have it waltz off to combat, and then it just goes away
(burned/discarded) at the end of combat? Is this right? If so, where
is the pulled vamp filled from...the blood bank, or, does the
methuselah pay from pool?

Question 3: Mass Reality. I think I know the answer to this one, just
want to double-check for sure...If you use Mass Reality to stack
damage with a weapon that does agg damage, how is the damage tallied?
Would a "superior" version of Mass Reality combined with...say...a
Flamethrower do 2 points of normal damage + 2 points of agg, or, 4
points of agg? I think it's the first one, but, I'm not 100% sure.

Thanks for the help...
Gwen Morse

Messages.Author: daniel frey
Messages.Body:
Gwen Morse wrote:
>
> Yes, I'm thinking about working on a Ravnos deck :). It just never
> ends with me, does it?

Welcome to the new found fun that is Ravnos. Probably my favorite clan
with which to play - just don't expect to win any tournaments with them.

> Question 1: Horrid Reality. Does this refer to weapons only as
> equipment? I would assume it does...since it says "weapon" through the
> greater part of the card text. However, the first line refers to the
> first peice of "equipment" found in the library. Is this a typo/errata
> issue, or, can the Ravnos be forced to equip with a laptop/sport
> bike/some other non-weapon equipment (and then have egg on their face
> in the ensuing combat as they can't fight for squat)?

Great card. I believe you pull a weapon out. I'm not sure about
cardtext, but I think it is pretty clear that it is discussing weapon
use. Great when used in combo w/ submachine guns/assualt rifles and
Dragon's Breath Rounds.

>
> Question 2: Illusions of the Kindred. I'm a bit puzzled about what the
> card text refers to. It seems to me that it refers to being able to
> take an uncontrolled vamp from the bottom of the crypt, fill it with
> blood, have it waltz off to combat, and then it just goes away
> (burned/discarded) at the end of combat? Is this right? If so, where
> is the pulled vamp filled from...the blood bank, or, does the
> methuselah pay from pool?
>

You understand the card pretty well, you take the blood for the new vamp
from the blood bank. Throw in a trap and go to town! This is my favorite
combat ends card!! It also trumps Psyche, Fast Reaction/Hidden Lurker,
and is a great response to a fight deck.

> Question 3: Mass Reality. I think I know the answer to this one, just
> want to double-check for sure...If you use Mass Reality to stack
> damage with a weapon that does agg damage, how is the damage tallied?
> Would a "superior" version of Mass Reality combined with...say...a
> Flamethrower do 2 points of normal damage + 2 points of agg, or, 4
> points of agg? I think it's the first one, but, I'm not 100% sure.
>

I believe you add two points normal damage followed by the agg damage.
It works well w/ the Sengir dagger for that added agg.

As for playing Chimestry (free advice that you can ignore). You will
find that nearly half your actions will be used to stem the massive
bloodcost of playing Chimestry, especially if you want to try Sensory
Dep. which generally costs 4blood to attempt (Sense Dep + Fata Morgana).
Blood dolls, Hunting Grounds, the Rack, Restorations are all necessary
cards w/ the Ravnos. The blood dolls will give you pool when you need
it, and can be used to give blood to vamps when they need that extra
little push.

Also, weenie Chimestry vamps suck. Weenies are almost always good, but
with Chimestry they generally don't have the blood to actually do
anything - and a lot of Chimestry is only good at superior.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
gold...@geocities.com (Gwen Morse) wrote:
> Question 1: Horrid Reality. Does this refer to weapons only as
> equipment?

Horrid Reality [DS] - Combat (ch) (2)

* Only pulls weapons out of the library, not simply equipment.
[RTR 960112]

> Question 2: Illusions of the Kindred. I'm a bit puzzled about what the
> card text refers to. It seems to me that it refers to being able to
> take an uncontrolled vamp from the bottom of the crypt, fill it with
> blood, have it waltz off to combat, and then it just goes away
> (burned/discarded) at the end of combat? Is this right?

Well, it is "removed from the game" at the end of combat, but the rest
of it is right.

> If so, where
> is the pulled vamp filled from...the blood bank, or, does the
> methuselah pay from pool?

Blood Bank.

> Question 3: Mass Reality. I think I know the answer to this one, just
> want to double-check for sure...If you use Mass Reality to stack
> damage with a weapon that does agg damage, how is the damage tallied?

Damage added to an aggravated source of damage is aggravated.

> Would a "superior" version of Mass Reality combined with...say...a
> Flamethrower do 2 points of normal damage + 2 points of agg, or, 4
> points of agg? I think it's the first one, but, I'm not 100% sure.

4R aggravated
